subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The code path looks sound, but the compatibility choice and overlapping open PRs require maintainer intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after rebase because it covers planner callbacks, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and does not filter returned tools.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select another open PR if maintainers prefer a smaller planner-only or descriptor-registration-only implementation, then close the non-canonical PRs after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised implementation if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to change tool filtering rather than only emit authoring diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after rebase because it covers planner callbacks, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and does not filter returned tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache compatibility and plugin resolver behavior, where the history points most strongly to steipete.
